guochan-showroom: Living room, bedroom and bathroom settings demonstrate building material applications, showing combinations of surfaces, edge details and lighting.

burger-ray: A metal counter, timber walls and pendant lights define the Burger-Ray interior, framing the ordering, preparation and seating areas.
